```python
def matching_skills(user, skills):
    normalized = user.casefold()
    user_words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", normalized))
    code_targets = {"code", "program", "software", "app", "script", "module"}
    source_file = bool(re.search(
        r"\b[\w.-]+\.(?:py|js|jsx|ts|tsx|java|c|cpp|h|hpp|cs|go|rs|rb|php|swift|kt|scala|sh|sql)\b",
        normalized,
    ))
    asks_code_change = bool(user_words & {"fix", "add", "change", "build", "improve"}) and (
        bool(user_words & code_targets) or source_file
    )
    asks_to_pass = bool(re.search(
        r"\bmake\b.*\bpass\b.*\b(?:score|tests?)\b",
        normalized,
    ))
    starts_with_plan = bool(re.match(r"^\s*/plan(?:\s|$)", normalized))

    matches = []
    for skill in skills:
        description = skill["description"].casefold()
        plan_rule = "starts with /plan" in description and starts_with_plan
        code_rule = (
            "asks to fix, add, change, build or improve code" in description
            and asks_code_change
        ) or (
            "make a program pass its score or tests" in description
            and asks_to_pass
        )
        if plan_rule or code_rule:
            matches.append(skill)
    return matches
```
